data.gender_notes: Bahurani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bahurani is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bahu’ meaning ‘many’ and ‘Rani’ meaning ‘queen’ or ‘goddess’. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name Bahurani bestows the blessings of wealth, fortune, and prosperity upon the bearer. The name Bahurani carries the meaning “Goddess of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bahurani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bahurani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahurani total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
